headline: Real Madrid-Rodri talks open; Barcola reports diverge
paragraphs: The best-corroborated story right now is Real Madrid's pursuit of Manchester City's Rodri. BBC's gossip column reported Real Madrid confident of signing him on July 24, then had City bracing for a bid by July 28. Sky Sports, reporting independently, said on July 29 that discussions had started between the two clubs, with a separate Sky piece examining how City would cope without him. Nothing is signed; City have not confirmed a deal, and this remains a reported pursuit.

Bradley Barcola's move from PSG to Liverpool looks less settled than one report suggests. BBC's gossip column said on July 29 that Barcola had verbally agreed to join Liverpool, with the clubs apart on valuation. Hours later, Sky Sports reported Liverpool were only set to open talks with PSG over a deal, an earlier stage than BBC described. Sky separately named Arsenal as a rival suitor, and BBC's gossip column had reported PSG wanting £145m for him two days earlier.
